title: Sections with support in a closed subscheme of an injective sheaf form an injective sheaf on the closed subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the sheaf of sections with support in a closed subscheme is injective on the closed subscheme whenever the original sheaf is injective (statement lines 14022-14028). The proof identifies the hom functor of H_Z(I) on Z_etale with the composite G -> Hom_X(i_*G, I), using that every section of i_*G is supported in Z (proof lines 14031-14037), and then uses exactness of i_* together with injectivity of I to see that this composite is exact, which is the defining property of injectivity (proof lines 14038-14040). The claim is H2: one identification of representing functors plus one exactness input, with the adjunction serving as the construction of the sheaf.
